Emtek 84052RECUS14KNUS19, Matte Black Knurled Cabinet Handle with Polished Nickel Mounts

The Black Knurled Cabinet Pull with Polished Nickel Mounts has an ultra modern look that is enhanced with the chic two-tone finish choice. The mounts are polished nickel while the textured bar is matte black for a stunning end result that is as contemporary as it gets. The Matte Black Knurled Cabinet Handle with Polished Nickel Mounts is available in a wide array of sizes ranging from 3-1/2 inches to 54 inch center to center lengths.

Specifications of the Emtek Select Knurled Cabinet Pulls:

  • Material: Brass
  • Stem Mount Finish: Polished Nickel
  • Bar Pull Finish: Matte Black
  • Comes packaged with installation screws.
  • Emtek Select Cabinet Pull Dimensions Diagram (PDF)
